answer: Agents bind identities to directional RF beacon attestations whose received power must track the swarm's ranging model, so a sybil cluster at the topology nadir cannot fake distinct positions without diverging from estimated state. When the tide of join requests rises, peers demand proof-of-location chaining through existing links, forcing each new identity to consume scarce. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
